Users ​

getUsers ​

swift
func getUsers(_ params: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. Returns {"list": [UserPublic, ...], "startKey": ..., "endOfList": Bool, "startKeyHistory": [...]}. See Searching Users.

keytype
searchForstringrequired: user_id, name, email, phone_number, address, gender, birthdate, locale, subscribers, timestamp, access_group, approved
valuestring, number, or an array of themrequired; type must match the field
conditionstring"=" (default), ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "gt", "gte", "eq", "lt", "lte"; anything else is read as "="
rangesame type as valuesearches from value to range

Without params: every user, newest sign-up first.

fetchOptions: limit (up to 1000), fetchMore, ascending, startKey. See Paging.

UserPublic keys: user_id, access_group, locale, approved, timestamp (sign-up, ms), log (last login, ms), subscribers, subscribed, records, and each profile field the user made public (email, name, address, gender, birthdate, phone_number, ...). anonymous: true on temporary accounts.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "searchFor" is required. / Key "value" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"<value>" is invalid in "searchFor". allowed types or values are: ...
INVALID_PARAMETERValue does not match the type of "<field>" index.
INVALID_PARAMETERConditions does not apply on range search.
INVALID_PARAMETERConditions are not allowed on a list of "<field>" values. Search for a single value to use a condition or range.
INVALID_PARAMETERValue should not be an empty string.

subscribe ​

swift
func subscribe(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. Subscribes to another user. See Subscriptions and Feed.

keytype
user_idstringrequired; the user to subscribe to, not yourself
get_feedbooltrue: the user's feed records appear in getFeed
get_notifiedboola preference saved with the subscription; the notifications are web push, delivered to browsers only
get_emailboolsaved with the subscription; true needs a verified e-mail

A new subscription starts with every option off; calling again changes only the options given.

Returns Subscription: {"subscriber", "subscription", "timestamp", "blocked", "get_feed", "get_notified", "get_email"}.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "user_id" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"user_id" cannot be the user's own ID. / "user_id" is empty. / "user_id" should be type: string. / "user_id" is invalid.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "get_feed". allowed type or value is: Type<boolean>. (same for get_notified)
INVALID_PARAMETERUser has no verified email address.
NOT_EXISTSThe user does not exists.
INVALID_REQUESTThe subscription is blocked.

unsubscribe ​

swift
func unsubscribe(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. params: ["user_id": String]. Returns SUCCESS: The user has unsubscribed., also when there was no subscription.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "user_id" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"user_id" cannot be the user's own ID. / "user_id" is empty. / "user_id" should be type: string. / "user_id" is invalid.
NOT_EXISTSThe user does not exists.
INVALID_REQUESTThe account is blocked from subscription group: 01.

blockSubscriber ​

swift
func blockSubscriber(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. params: ["user_id": String]. Stops that user from reading your subscription records and getting your feed records. Works on users who never subscribed. Returns SUCCESS: Blocked user ID "<user_id>".

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "user_id" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"user_id" cannot be the user's own ID. / "user_id" is empty. / "user_id" should be type: string. / "user_id" is invalid.
INVALID_REQUESTCannot block/unblock service owner.

unblockSubscriber ​

swift
func unblockSubscriber(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. params: ["user_id": String]. A blocked subscriber gets their subscription back with the options they had. Returns SUCCESS: Unblocked user ID "<user_id>".

Errors ​

Same as blockSubscriber.

getSubscriptions ​

swift
func getSubscriptions(_ params: JSON, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. Returns {"list": [Subscription, ...], "startKey", "endOfList", "startKeyHistory"}; each row is {"subscriber", "subscription", "timestamp", "blocked"}.

keytype
subscriberstringuser ID of the subscriber: lists who they subscribe to
subscriptionstringuser ID of the user subscribed to: lists their subscribers, blocked ones included. Your own ID lists your own subscribers.
blockedbooltrue lists only blocked rows. With subscriber alone, anything else lists only active ones.

At least one of subscriber or subscription is required. Both: that one subscription, or an empty list.

fetchOptions: limit, fetchMore, ascending (default true), startKey. See Paging.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERUser ID in "subscriber" is empty. / User ID in "subscriber" should be type: string. / User ID in "subscriber" is invalid.
INVALID_PARAMETERUser ID in "subscription" is empty. / User ID in "subscription" should be type: string. / User ID in "subscription" is invalid.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "blocked". allowed type or value is: Type<boolean>.
INVALID_PARAMETERAt least either "subscriber" or "subscription" should have a value.

getFeed ​

swift
func getFeed(_ params: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. Records posted with upload_to_feed by the users you subscribe to with get_feed, newest first. Returns {"list": [record, ...], "startKey", "endOfList", "startKeyHistory"}; each record as in The record. A new record can take a few seconds to appear.

keytype
access_groupnumber, "public" or "authorized"which records: 0 to your own access group. Default 1 ("authorized").

fetchOptions: limit (default 100), fetchMore, ascending (default false), startKey.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"access_group" should be type number.
INVALID_PARAMETER"access_group" should be zero or a positive number.
INVALID_PARAMETERUser has no access.

subscribeNewsletter ​

swift
func subscribeNewsletter(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Subscribes an e-mail to one newsletter group. See Newsletters.

keytype
groupnumber, stringrequired: 0 or "public", 1 or "authorized", 2 to 99, or a group name
emailstringrequired when signed out; ignored when signed in (the account's verified e-mail is used)
redirectstringsigned out: the URL the confirmation link lands on

Returns the server's message:

  • signed in: SUCCESS: User's email has been successfully subscribed to the newsletter.
  • signed out: SUCCESS: Subscribe confirmation e-mail has been sent. (or SUCCESS: User's e-mail has been successfully subscribed to the newsletter. when already subscribed)

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot subscribe to newsletters.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "group" is required. / Key "email" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"group" should be an integer between 0 and 99.
INVALID_PARAMETERNewsletter group name must be 2-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters, contain a letter, and not be a reserved name.
INVALID_PARAMETER"email" should be at least 5 characters. / "<email>" is an invalid email.
INVALID_PARAMETER"<url>" is an invalid url.
INVALID_REQUESTUser's email needs to be verified.
INVALID_REQUESTNo access. / Access denied. Your access group is insufficient to subscribe to group "<name>".
INVALID_REQUESTOnly authenticated users have access to "group". (signed out, group 1 to 99)
INVALID_REQUESTGroup "<name>" does not exist for service "<project id>".
INVALID_REQUESTNewsletter subscriber limit reached. Consider upgrading your plan.

unsubscribeNewsletter ​

swift
func unsubscribeNewsletter(group: JSON?) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. group as in subscribeNewsletter; nil unsubscribes from every group: unsubscribeNewsletter(group: nil). Returns SUCCESS: <email> has been unsubscribed from group <group>. (numeric groups as two digits, such as 01) or SUCCESS: <email> has been unsubscribed from all groups.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot subscribe to newsletters.
INVALID_PARAMETER"group" should be an integer between 0 and 99. / Newsletter group name must be 2-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters, contain a letter, and not be a reserved name.

getNewsletters ​

swift
func getNewsletters(_ params: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Newsletters sent to a group. Without params: the public newsletter (group 0), newest first. Returns {"list": [Newsletter, ...], "startKey", "endOfList", "startKeyHistory"}.

keytype
searchForstringrequired: message_id, timestamp, subject, complaint, read, bounced
valuestring for message_id and subject, number otherwiserequired
groupnumber, stringrequired; as in subscribeNewsletter
conditionstring"=" (default), ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "gt", "gte", "eq", "lt", "lte"; anything else is read as "="
rangesame type as valuesearches from value to range

Group 0 and named groups open to anyone can be read signed out. Groups 1 to 99 need a signed-in user whose access group is at least the group.

fetchOptions: limit (default 50), fetchMore, ascending, startKey.

Newsletter keys: message_id, timestamp, subject, url (the newsletter to read), group, and complaint, read, bounced, delivered, dry (filled in for the project owner only; 0, "" or false for users).

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "searchFor" is required. / Key "value" is required. / Key "group" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"<value>" is invalid in "searchFor". allowed types or values are: "message_id", "timestamp", "subject", "complaint", "read", "bounced".
INVALID_PARAMETER"value" type does not match the type of "<searchFor>" index. / "value" should not be empty string.
INVALID_PARAMETER"range" should match type of "value".
INVALID_PARAMETERUser should be logged in. / User has no access.
INVALID_REQUESTNo access. / Access denied. Your access group is insufficient to subscribe to group "<name>".

getNewsletterSubscription ​

swift
func getNewsletterSubscription(_ params: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in users only. The user's own newsletter subscriptions, all at once. params: ["group": ...] to list one group (as in subscribeNewsletter); left out: every group.

Returns a JSON array: [{"timestamp", "group", "subscribed_email", "active"}, ...]. group is a number for numeric groups and the name for named groups; active is false while the subscription is inactive or unconfirmed.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot subscribe to newsletters.
INVALID_PARAMETER"group" should be an integer between 0 and 99. / Newsletter group name must be 2-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters, contain a letter, and not be a reserved name.

func sendInquiry(_ data: JSON) async throws -> String

subjectstringrequired
messagestringrequired

Returns SUCCESS: Inquiry has been sent.

INVALID_PARAMETER"email" should be type: string. / "email" should be at least 5 characters. / "<email>" is an invalid email.
ERRORProject does not allow inquiry.
